task_name: Frontend — Page filter chips, empty states, error handling, drawer wiring

concerns_addressed: Default {New,Confirmed}+30d chips are real buttons with aria-pressed; empty selection preserved to no-request state (page.tsx toggleStatus/no-revert + normalizeStatuses empty passthrough)
Semua toggles all four canonical statuses (page.tsx toggleSemua/statuses.length check)
Filter math via T1 computeFilteredCounts status x period wiring (page.tsx filteredPoints useMemo)
Empty-state precedence strict: sectionUnavailable > all-invalid with count > zero-orders with no coordinate warning (page.tsx mapContent branches)
outlets_without_daily_detail computed for narrow periods via daily_by_status absence + 30d window-orders guard, 0 for 30d, disclosed via testid (page.tsx outletsWithoutDailyDetail memo)
Unknown deep-link status/period safely falls back to default without throw (page.tsx URLSearchParams every/includes guards + normalize fallback)

Typed-error classification branches on ApiError.status (401 clears token + Sesi berakhir, 403 Akses ditolak no retry, else Tidak dapat memuat data peta + Coba lagi); geographic cleared to null so no stale snapshot (page.tsx loadAll catch)
Admin role verified via /auth/me before token set; loadAll/withDummyRead gated on admin token so non-admin dummy never reads geographic (page.tsx useAdminGuard + useEffect/useDummyRefresh guards)
Freshness label from window.end + timezone + snapshot_version via formatSnapshotEnd, no new Date() and no live claim (page.tsx SnapshotMetadata)

Drawer wiring passes frozen openingFilter copy + live currentFilter + window; freeze/banner/focus/dialog semantics owned by OutletDrawer useFrozenSnapshot/filtersEqual (page.tsx onSelectOutlet + OutletDrawer props)

strengths: Chips are real <button type="button"> with aria-pressed; Semua toggles all four via toggleSemua
Empty status selection preserved as real state rendering no-request message, never silently reverted; normalizeStatuses empty preserved
outlets_without_daily_detail computed from daily_by_status absence plus 30d window counts and disclosed via testid for narrow periods, 0 for 30d
Unknown deep-link status/period safely falls back to {New,Confirmed}+30d via every/some guards plus normalizeStatuses/normalizePeriod
Retry button rendered only when retryable (5xx/network); 403 no retry, 401 clears token and shows session-expired
Freshness label from window.end + timezone + snapshot_version via formatSnapshotEnd; no new Date()
Role checked via /auth/me admin guard before any loadAll/withDummyRead; token-gated fetch plus useDummyRefresh reload; non-admin denied with no geographic fetch
Stale geographic cleared on ApiError (geographic:null); frozen drawer snapshot via openingFilter/currentFilter with freeze banner

issues.description: DataIntelligencePage component exceeds 50 lines and file approaches ~300 lines, but logic is decomposed into useAdminGuard, SnapshotMetadata, memos and delegated tables/map/drawer; no further split required in-scope.
outlets-without-daily-detail paragraph renders even when sectionUnavailable (Data peta belum tersedia); noisy but does not hide precedence.
formatSnapshotEnd assumes valid YYYY-MM-DD without validation; SnapshotMetadata relies on snapshot_version null guard to avoid null-window dereference.
